title.en: LU7–LU11 + LI1 · Serratus anterior and trapezius

description: DPT 基础第 2 天：前锯肌、斜方肌，上回旋力偶与翼状肩胛；手太阴肺经 LU7–LU11 与大肠经商阳。
today_line: 今天：6 个新穴位（列缺、经渠、太渊、鱼际、少商、商阳）· 2 块新肌肉（前锯肌、斜方肌）· 复习 9 张旧卡
study_plan: 01 肌肉、04 穴位的图，对着自己的背和手腕找
05 章记忆卡 + 复习中心里的旧卡
06 章读两遍，用新词造一句
footer: DPT 基础 · 第 2 天 · 定位依据 GB/T 12346-2021 与 WHO 2008；层次为学习用的简化描述，不代表进针方向或深度。

vertical: 解剖学/上肢/肩带/肩胛骨肌群
神经科学/周围神经/胸长神经与副神经
运动学/生物力学/肩胛胸壁关节/上回旋力偶
中医针灸对照/经络/手太阴肺经
中医针灸对照/经络/手阳明大肠经
horizontal: 中西医对照/穴位-触发点

o: Outer surfaces of ribs 1–8 (some texts: 1–9), by fleshy digitations
第 1–8 肋外面（部分教材为第 1–9 肋），以肌齿起始
i: Costal (anterior) surface of the medial border of the scapula, from the superior angle to the inferior angle
肩胛骨内侧缘的肋面（前面），从上角到下角
n: Long thoracic nerve (C5–C7), which arises directly from the roots of the brachial plexus
胸长神经（C5–C7），直接起自臂丛的神经根
a: Protracts the scapula and holds its medial border against the chest wall; the lower part rotates the scapula upward, so the arm can rise above 90°
使肩胛骨前伸，并让内侧缘贴紧胸壁；下部使肩胛骨上回旋，手臂才能上举超过 90°
sentence: The serratus anterior originates from the outer surfaces of the first eight (or nine) ribs, passes backward around the lateral thoracic wall, and inserts onto the anterior surface of the medial border of the scapula, from the superior angle to the inferior angle.
前锯肌起自第1–8（或9）肋的外面，绕胸廓外侧壁向后走行，止于肩胛骨内侧缘的前面（从上角到下角）。
extra_pairs: The long thoracic nerve runs down the anterior chest wall in the mid-axillary line on the superficial surface of serratus anterior. This exposed course is why the nerve is easily injured. The lateral thoracic artery also supplies the muscle.
胸长神经沿腋中线走在前锯肌的浅面，位置表浅，因此容易受伤。胸外侧动脉也供应此肌。

A long thoracic nerve injury paralyses serratus anterior and causes MEDIAL scapular winging: the scapula moves up and its inferior angle rotates toward the midline. Patients have trouble flexing the shoulder past about 120°. To test, have the patient do a push-up (or wall push) with the shoulders flexed to 90°. Causes include radical mastectomy, axillary node dissection, chest drains, first-rib resection, compression or entrapment by the scalenes, and traction.
胸长神经损伤使前锯肌瘫痪，出现“内侧型翼状肩胛”：肩胛骨上移，下角转向中线。患者肩前屈很难超过约120°。检查方法：让患者在肩前屈90°时做俯卧撑（或推墙）。病因包括根治性乳房切除术、腋窝淋巴结清扫、胸腔引流、第1肋切除、斜角肌压迫或卡压，以及牵拉伤。

Feel it: flex your arm forward and push (or punch) against resistance, such as a wall. Put the fingertips of your other hand on the side of your rib cage just below the armpit. You can feel the saw-tooth digitations tighten over the ribs.
自己摸：上肢前屈，抵抗阻力向前推（如推墙或出拳）。用另一手指尖放在腋下稍下方的胸廓侧面，可摸到锯齿状肌齿在肋骨上收紧。
muscles.acu: 大包 SP21 在其下部肌齿表面（第 6 肋间隙、腋中线上，脾经时再学）
muscles.acu_en: Dabao (SP21) lies over its lower digitations in the 6th intercostal space, mid-axillary line (spleen meridian, later)
i_short: Medial border, costal surface (superior → inferior angle)
肩胛骨内侧缘肋面（上角至下角）
a_short: Protraction; upward rotation (inferior part); holds scapula to thorax
前伸；上回旋（下部）；使肩胛骨贴紧胸壁

o: External occipital protuberance, medial third of the superior nuchal line, ligamentum nuchae, and the spinous processes of C7–T12
枕外隆凸、上项线内侧 1/3、项韧带及 C7–T12 棘突
i: Lateral third of the clavicle (upper part); medial margin of the acromion and upper crest of the scapular spine (middle part); medial end of the spine (lower part)
锁骨外侧 1/3（上部）；肩峰内侧缘和肩胛冈上缘（中部）；肩胛冈内侧端，即冈根（下部）
n: Motor: spinal accessory nerve (CN XI). Sensory and proprioceptive: ventral rami of C3–C4
运动：副神经（第 XI 对脑神经）。感觉与本体感觉：C3–C4 前支
a: Upper fibres elevate and upwardly rotate the scapula (and extend the head and neck); middle fibres retract it; lower fibres depress it and help rotate it upward
上部纤维使肩胛骨上提、上回旋（并使头颈后伸）；中部使其后缩；下部使其下降并协助上回旋
sentence: The trapezius originates from the external occipital protuberance, the superior nuchal line, the ligamentum nuchae and the spinous processes of C7–T12, passes laterally as converging upper, middle and lower fibers, and inserts onto the lateral third of the clavicle, the acromion and the spine of the scapula.
斜方肌起自枕外隆凸、上项线、项韧带及C7–T12棘突，以上、中、下三部纤维向外侧汇聚，止于锁骨外侧1/3、肩峰和肩胛冈。
extra_pairs: The spinal accessory nerve leaves the skull through the jugular foramen, crosses the posterior triangle of the neck, then passes beneath (deep to) the trapezius to supply it. The anterior margin of trapezius forms the posterior border of the posterior triangle. Trapezius covers the rhomboids, the lower part of levator scapulae, serratus posterior superior and the splenius/erector spinae group.
副神经经颈静脉孔出颅，穿过颈后三角，再走到斜方肌深面并支配该肌。斜方肌前缘构成颈后三角的后界。斜方肌覆盖菱形肌、肩胛提肌下部、上后锯肌以及夹肌/竖脊肌群。

Spinal accessory nerve injury in the posterior triangle is most often iatrogenic, for example during cervical lymph node biopsy or excision. When the nerve is injured within the posterior triangle, only trapezius is denervated. The result is trapezius wasting, shoulder droop, weak shrug and abduction, and LATERAL scapular winging: the scapula moves down and its inferior angle rotates outward. Test it with a resisted shoulder shrug.
颈后三角内的副神经损伤最常为医源性，例如颈部淋巴结活检或切除时。若损伤发生在颈后三角内，只有斜方肌失神经。表现为斜方肌萎缩、肩下垂、耸肩和外展无力，以及“外侧型翼状肩胛”：肩胛骨下移，下角向外旋。检查方法：抗阻耸肩。

Feel it: upper fibers: rest the fingers of your opposite hand on the top of your shoulder, between the neck and the acromion, and shrug against your own downward pressure. The thick upper border tightens under your fingers. (Clinicians test it the same way, with a resisted shrug.)
自己摸：上部纤维：用对侧手指放在颈与肩峰之间的肩上缘，对抗自己向下的压力耸肩，可感到肥厚的上缘在指下收紧。（临床以抗阻耸肩检查。）
muscles.acu: 肩井 GB21 在其上部纤维上（胆经时再学）；秉风、曲垣在其深面的冈上窝
muscles.acu_en: Jianjing (GB21) sits on its upper fibres (gallbladder meridian, later); Bingfeng and Quyuan lie deep to it in the supraspinous fossa
o_short: Occiput, nuchal ligament, spinous processes C7–T12
i_short: Lateral ⅓ clavicle, acromion, scapular spine
n_short: Spinal accessory n. (CN XI); C3–C4 sensory
a_short: Upper: elevate + upward rotate · middle: retract · lower: depress + upward rotate
上部：上提 + 上回旋；中部：后缩；下部：下降 + 上回旋

acupoints.name: 列缺
acupoints.loc: 在前臂外侧，腕掌侧远端横纹上 1.5 寸，拇短伸肌腱与拇长展肌腱之间，拇长展肌腱沟的凹陷中
acupoints.loc_en: On the radial aspect of the forearm, between the tendons of the abductor pollicis longus and the extensor pollicis brevis muscles, in the groove for the abductor pollicis longus tendon, 1.5 B-cun superior to the palmar wrist crease.
acupoints.loc_short: Radial forearm, 1.5 B-cun above palmar wrist crease, in the APL tendon groove between the APL and EPB tendons.
acupoints.layers: 皮肤 → 皮下组织（头静脉属支、桡神经浅支）→ 拇短伸肌腱与拇长展肌腱之间（旧教材作：肱桡肌腱与拇长展肌腱之间）→ 旋前方肌桡侧缘
acupoints.safety: 浅层有头静脉属支和桡神经浅支；教材刺法为向肘部斜刺
acupoints.muscles: 拇长展肌腱、拇短伸肌腱；深面旋前方肌
acupoints.find: 两手虎口交叉，一手食指按在另一手桡骨茎突上，指尖下的凹陷就是列缺（见图 08）
acupoints.special: 络穴；八脉交会穴（通任脉）

acupoints.name: 经渠
acupoints.loc: 在前臂前外侧，腕掌侧远端横纹上 1 寸，桡骨茎突与桡动脉之间
acupoints.loc_en: On the anterolateral aspect of the forearm, between the radial styloid process and the radial artery, 1 B-cun superior to the palmar wrist crease.
acupoints.loc_short: 1 B-cun above the palmar wrist crease, between the radial styloid process and the radial artery (1 B-cun above LU9).
acupoints.layers: 皮肤 → 皮下组织（前臂外侧皮神经、桡神经浅支）→ 桡侧腕屈肌腱与拇长展肌腱之间，桡动、静脉的桡侧 → 旋前方肌
acupoints.safety: 紧贴桡动脉的桡侧：避开动脉；教材记载禁灸
acupoints.muscles: 桡侧腕屈肌腱、拇长展肌腱；深面旋前方肌
acupoints.find: 太渊上 1 寸，约平腕掌侧近端横纹；在桡骨茎突内缘与桡动脉之间的凹陷
acupoints.special: 经穴（五输穴之经穴，肺经“所行为经”）

acupoints.name: 太渊
acupoints.loc: 在腕前外侧，桡骨茎突与腕舟状骨之间，拇长展肌腱尺侧凹陷中（腕掌侧远端横纹桡侧，桡动脉搏动处）
acupoints.loc_en: On the anterolateral aspect of the wrist, between the radial styloid process and the scaphoid bone, in the depression ulnar to the abductor pollicis longus tendon. Note: On the radial side of the palmar wrist crease, over the radial artery.
acupoints.loc_short: Radial end of the palmar wrist crease, between radial styloid and scaphoid, ulnar to the APL tendon, over the radial pulse.
acupoints.layers: 皮肤 → 皮下组织（前臂外侧皮神经、桡神经浅支）→ 桡侧腕屈肌腱与拇长展肌腱之间，桡动、静脉所在
acupoints.safety: 穴位就在桡动脉上：先摸到脉，再避开动脉
acupoints.muscles: 拇长展肌腱、桡侧腕屈肌腱
acupoints.find: 仰掌，在腕掌侧远端横纹的桡侧端摸到桡动脉搏动，即拇长展肌腱尺侧的凹陷
acupoints.special: 输穴；原穴；八会穴之脉会（教材A：“穴属俞土，系原穴”）

acupoints.name: 鱼际
acupoints.loc: 在手掌，第1掌骨桡侧中点赤白肉际处。
acupoints.loc_en: On the palm, radial to the midpoint of the first metacarpal bone, at the border between the red and white flesh.
acupoints.loc_short: Radial to the midpoint of the 1st metacarpal, at the palmar–dorsal skin junction (thenar eminence).
acupoints.layers: 皮肤 → 皮下组织（前臂外侧皮神经、正中神经分支）→ 拇短展肌 → 拇对掌肌（旧教材写作“拇指掌肌”）
acupoints.safety: 皮下有前臂外侧皮神经与正中神经分支
acupoints.muscles: 拇短展肌、拇对掌肌（大鱼际肌）
acupoints.find: 仰掌，在第 1 掌骨中点的桡侧，手掌与手背皮肤交界的赤白肉际处

acupoints.name: 少商
acupoints.loc: 在手指，拇指末节桡侧，指甲根角侧上方0.1寸。
acupoints.loc_en: On the thumb, radial to the distal phalanx, 0.1 F-cun proximal-lateral to the radial corner of the thumb nail.
acupoints.loc_short: 0.1 F-cun proximal-lateral to the radial corner of the thumbnail.
acupoints.layers: 皮肤 → 皮下组织（指端动脉网；桡神经、正中神经的分支）
acupoints.safety: 穴下只有皮下组织：教材为浅刺或点刺出血
acupoints.find: 拇指桡侧，沿指甲桡侧缘与甲根各画一线，交点外 0.1 寸（沿角平分线，见图 08）

acupoints.name: 商阳
acupoints.loc: 在手指，食指末节桡侧，指甲根角侧上方0.1寸。
acupoints.loc_en: On the index finger, radial to the distal phalanx, 0.1 F-cun proximal-lateral to the radial corner of the index fingernail.
acupoints.loc_short: 0.1 F-cun proximal-lateral to the radial corner of the index fingernail.
acupoints.layers: 皮肤 → 皮下组织（指端动脉网；正中神经的指掌侧固有神经）
acupoints.safety: 穴下只有皮下组织：教材为浅刺或点刺出血
acupoints.find: 食指桡侧，沿指甲桡侧缘与甲根各画一线，交点外 0.1 寸（见图 08）
acupoints.special: 井穴（大肠经井穴；教材A称“井金穴”）

title: How to remember them
三步记住这两块肌肉
steps: Push against a wall with your arm forward and feel the saw-tooth slips under your armpit: serratus anterior. Shrug against your other hand's pressure and feel the thick upper border tighten: upper trapezius.
手臂前伸推墙，腋下稍下方能摸到锯齿状的肌齿在收紧：前锯肌。另一只手向下压着肩，同时耸肩，肩上缘变硬：斜方肌上部。
Draw a kite from the occiput down to T12 and out to both acromia: that is the pair of trapezius muscles. Then draw eight tongues from ribs 1–8 sweeping back under the scapula: serratus anterior.
从枕骨画到 T12，再向两侧连到肩峰，画成一个风筝形：左右两块斜方肌。再从第 1–8 肋画 8 条舌形肌齿，向后钻到肩胛骨下面：前锯肌。

Punch forward (serratus: protraction), shrug (upper trapezius: elevation), squeeze the shoulder blades together (middle trapezius: retraction), then raise both arms overhead and feel all three turn the scapula upward.
向前出拳（前锯肌：前伸）、耸肩（斜方肌上部：上提）、夹紧两侧肩胛骨（斜方肌中部：后缩），最后双臂上举，体会三股力一起让肩胛骨上回旋。
hook: SA: ribs 1–8, C5–C7 · Trap: C7–T12, CN XI
前锯肌——肋 1–8、C5–C7；斜方肌——C7–T12 棘突、副神经

sources: OUHSC: What drives upward rotation of the scapula?

title: Muscles: serratus anterior and trapezius
今日肌肉：前锯肌与斜方肌
goals: Name both muscles in English and Chinese and say which bone each one moves.
用英文和中文说出两块肌肉，并说出它们带动的是哪块骨。
State origin, insertion, nerve and action of each, part by part for trapezius.
说出两块肌肉的起点、止点、神经和动作，斜方肌按三部分说。
Feel both on yourself: a wall push and a shrug.
在自己身上摸到它们：推墙和耸肩。

blocks.en: Yesterday's pectoral muscles pull on the humerus and the coracoid. Today's two muscles anchor the scapula itself: the trapezius covers the back of the neck and upper back, and the serratus anterior wraps around the side of the chest and slips under the scapula to its medial border.
blocks.zh: 昨天的胸前肌拉的是肱骨和喙突。今天的两块肌肉直接固定肩胛骨本身：斜方肌覆盖颈后和上背部；前锯肌绕过胸廓侧面，钻到肩胛骨深面，止于内侧缘。

blocks.en: A: trapezius in posterior view, its three parts coloured. B: serratus anterior in right lateral view with the upper limb removed; the scapula is drawn see-through.
blocks.zh: A：斜方肌后面观，三部分分色。B：前锯肌右侧面观（已移去上肢），肩胛骨画成透明。

blocks.en: Origins, insertions, and course
blocks.zh: 起点、止点与走行

blocks.en: O = origin; I = insertion. The dashed O → I line shows the attachment order only; the pulls and the rotation they produce are drawn with solid arrows in Chapter 03.
blocks.zh: O 表示起点，I 表示止点。虚线 O → I 只表示附着顺序；拉力和由此产生的转动在第 03 章用实线箭头表示。

check: Which surface of the scapula does the serratus anterior attach to, and why can't you see it from behind?
前锯肌附着在肩胛骨的哪一面？为什么从后面看不到？
The costal (anterior) surface of the medial border. It lies between the scapula and the ribs, hidden under the scapula.
附着在内侧缘的肋面（前面）。它夹在肩胛骨和肋骨之间，被肩胛骨挡住。
Where does each part of the trapezius insert?
斜方肌三部分分别止于哪里？
Upper fibres: lateral third of the clavicle. Middle fibres: medial acromion and the upper crest of the scapular spine. Lower fibres: the root (medial end) of the spine.
上部：锁骨外侧 1/3；中部：肩峰内侧缘与肩胛冈上缘；下部：肩胛冈内侧端（冈根）。
take: Serratus anterior: ribs 1–8 → costal surface of the medial border. Trapezius: occiput and C7–T12 → lateral clavicle, acromion and scapular spine, in three parts.
前锯肌：第 1–8 肋 → 内侧缘肋面。斜方肌：枕骨与 C7–T12 → 锁骨外侧、肩峰和肩胛冈，分上、中、下三部。
bridge: Next: the two nerves, and why each is easy to injure. 下一章：两条神经，以及它们为什么容易受伤。

title: Innervation: long thoracic and spinal accessory nerves
神经支配：胸长神经与副神经
goals: Trace the long thoracic nerve from C5–C7 to the serratus anterior.
从 C5–C7 追踪胸长神经到前锯肌。
Trace the spinal accessory nerve from the upper cervical cord to the trapezius.
从颈髓上段追踪副神经到斜方肌。
Explain where each nerve is exposed and what happens when it is cut.
说出每条神经在哪里位置表浅，损伤后会怎样。

blocks.title: C = Cervical · 颈部   CN = Cranial nerve · 脑神经
items: 神经根直接发出 → 胸长神经 → 前锯肌
副神经（运动）→ 斜方肌（也支配胸锁乳突肌）
前支加入：斜方肌的感觉与本体感觉纤维

blocks.en: A: the long thoracic nerve leaves the C5–C7 roots before the trunks form and runs down the mid-axillary line on the serratus surface. B: the spinal accessory nerve rises from the upper cervical cord, enters the skull through the foramen magnum, exits through the jugular foramen, crosses the posterior triangle and runs on the deep surface of the trapezius.
blocks.zh: A：胸长神经在形成干之前直接由 C5–C7 神经根发出，沿腋中线走在前锯肌表面。B：副神经起自颈髓上段，经枕骨大孔入颅，再经颈静脉孔出颅，穿过颈后三角，在斜方肌深面下行。

blocks.en: The long thoracic nerve (C5–C7) arises directly from the roots of the brachial plexus. It descends behind the plexus and then runs down the lateral chest wall, in the mid-axillary line, on the outer surface of the serratus anterior. Because it lies on top of the muscle it supplies, it is easily injured by surgery in the axilla or by traction.
blocks.zh: 胸长神经（C5–C7）直接起自臂丛的神经根，在臂丛后方下行，然后沿腋中线走在胸外侧壁、前锯肌的外表面。它走在自己所支配肌肉的表面，所以腋窝手术或牵拉时容易受伤。

blocks.en: The spinal accessory nerve (CN XI) is the motor nerve of the trapezius. Its fibres rise from the upper cervical spinal cord, enter the skull through the foramen magnum and leave it again through the jugular foramen. The nerve supplies the sternocleidomastoid, crosses the posterior triangle of the neck just under the skin, and then passes deep to the trapezius. Ventral rami of C3 and C4 join it and carry sensory and proprioceptive fibres.
blocks.zh: 副神经（第 XI 对脑神经）是斜方肌的运动神经。它的纤维起自颈髓上段，经枕骨大孔入颅，再经颈静脉孔出颅；先支配胸锁乳突肌，然后在皮下穿过颈后三角，再走到斜方肌深面。C3、C4 的前支加入，携带感觉和本体感觉纤维。
Long → medial：胸长神经损伤 → 内侧型翼状肩胛；Accessory → lateral：副神经损伤 → 外侧型翼状肩胛（图 06）。
blocks.label: 记法

check: Which nerve supplies serratus anterior, from which roots, and what sign appears when it is injured?
前锯肌由哪条神经支配？来自哪些神经根？损伤后出现什么体征？

The long thoracic nerve (C5–C7). Injury causes medial scapular winging: the scapula translates upward and its inferior angle rotates medially. The winging is easiest to see during a push-up or wall push with the shoulders flexed to 90°.
胸长神经（C5–C7）。损伤后出现内侧型翼状肩胛：肩胛骨上移，下角向内旋转。在肩前屈90°做俯卧撑或推墙时最明显。
Why is the spinal accessory nerve at risk during a lymph-node biopsy in the neck?
为什么颈部淋巴结活检时副神经容易受伤？
Between the sternocleidomastoid and the trapezius it crosses the posterior triangle just under the skin, where the lymph nodes are. In the posterior triangle only the trapezius is denervated.
它在胸锁乳突肌和斜方肌之间、紧贴皮下穿过颈后三角，正是淋巴结所在的位置。若损伤发生在颈后三角，只有斜方肌失神经。
take: Long thoracic nerve: C5–C7 roots → serratus anterior, exposed on the chest wall. Spinal accessory nerve: CN XI → trapezius (C3–C4 add sensory fibres), exposed in the posterior triangle.
胸长神经：C5–C7 神经根 → 前锯肌，在胸壁表面走行。副神经：CN XI → 斜方肌（C3–C4 带来感觉纤维），在颈后三角位置表浅。
bridge: Next: how the two muscles turn the scapula together. 下一章：两块肌肉如何一起转动肩胛骨。

title: Movement: the upward-rotation force couple
动作：上回旋力偶
goals: Name the three pulls that rotate the scapula upward and where each one acts.
说出使肩胛骨上回旋的三股拉力，以及各自作用在哪里。
Explain how the partners change between early and late elevation.
说明上举早期和后期配对如何变化。
Tell medial from lateral winging and link each to its nerve.
区分内侧型和外侧型翼状肩胛，并对应到神经。

blocks.en: A: upper trapezius pulls the acromion up and in, lower trapezius pulls the root of the spine down, and the lower serratus pulls the inferior angle out and forward; together they rotate the scapula upward. B: who leads during arm elevation (qualitative, not EMG values).
blocks.zh: A：斜方肌上部把肩峰拉向内上，下部把冈根拉向下，前锯肌下部把下角拉向外前方，三者合起来使肩胛骨上回旋。B：抬臂过程中由谁主导（定性示意，不是肌电数值）。

blocks.en: Raising the arm overhead needs the glenoid to turn upward. Three pulls acting on different points of the scapula produce this rotation: the upper trapezius at the lateral clavicle and acromion, the lower trapezius at the root of the spine, and the lower part of the serratus anterior at the inferior angle. Pulls on different points, turning the same bone the same way, form a force couple.
blocks.zh: 手臂举过头需要关节盂转向上。三股拉力作用在肩胛骨的不同位置，合成这个转动：斜方肌上部拉锁骨外侧和肩峰，斜方肌下部拉冈根，前锯肌下部拉下角。作用在不同点、使同一块骨朝同一方向转动的几股力，就叫力偶。

blocks.en: Early in elevation the upper trapezius and serratus anterior rotate the scapula around an axis near the sternoclavicular joint. Once the costoclavicular ligament becomes taut, the axis moves to the acromioclavicular joint and the lower trapezius takes over from the upper part. The middle trapezius retracts the scapula and balances serratus protraction, so the scapula turns instead of sliding forward.
blocks.zh: 上举早期，斜方肌上部和前锯肌使肩胛骨围绕胸锁关节附近的轴转动。肋锁韧带拉紧后，旋转轴移到肩锁关节，由斜方肌下部接替上部。斜方肌中部使肩胛骨后缩，平衡前锯肌的前伸，让肩胛骨原地转动而不向前滑。

blocks.en: A: medial winging (long thoracic nerve, serratus anterior). B: lateral winging (spinal accessory nerve, trapezius). Dashed outlines show the normal position.
blocks.zh: A：内侧型翼状肩胛（胸长神经、前锯肌）。B：外侧型翼状肩胛（副神经、斜方肌）。虚线为正常位置。

blocks.en: If the serratus anterior is weak, it can no longer hold the scapula against the chest wall: the scapula rides up, its inferior angle swings toward the midline and the medial border lifts off, most clearly during a wall push. If the trapezius is weak, the shoulder droops: the scapula sits lower, its inferior angle turns outward, and a resisted shrug is weak.
blocks.zh: 前锯肌无力时，肩胛骨不能贴紧胸壁：肩胛骨上移，下角转向中线，内侧缘翘起，推墙时最明显。斜方肌无力时，肩下垂：肩胛骨位置偏低，下角转向外，抗阻耸肩无力。

check: Name the muscles of the upward-rotation force couple and explain how the pairing changes during arm elevation.
说出上回旋力偶的组成肌肉，并说明上举过程中配对如何变化。

Upper trapezius, lower trapezius and serratus anterior. Early on, the upper trapezius and serratus anterior rotate the scapula around a sternoclavicular axis. After the costoclavicular ligament tightens, the axis moves to the acromioclavicular joint and the lower trapezius and serratus anterior produce the rotation.
斜方肌上部、斜方肌下部和前锯肌。早期由斜方肌上部和前锯肌围绕胸锁关节轴使肩胛骨上回旋；肋锁韧带拉紧后，旋转轴移到肩锁关节，由斜方肌下部和前锯肌产生上回旋。
A patient's scapula rides up and its medial border lifts off during a wall push. Which muscle and nerve?
患者推墙时肩胛骨上移、内侧缘翘起。是哪块肌肉、哪条神经？
Serratus anterior, long thoracic nerve: medial winging.
前锯肌，胸长神经：内侧型翼状肩胛。
take: Upward rotation = upper trapezius + lower trapezius + serratus anterior, pulling at three points of the scapula; middle trapezius keeps it from sliding forward.
上回旋 = 斜方肌上部 + 斜方肌下部 + 前锯肌，在肩胛骨三个点上拉；斜方肌中部防止它向前滑。
bridge: Next: the last five lung points and the first point of the large intestine meridian. 下一章：肺经最后 5 穴与大肠经第 1 穴。

title: Acupoints: LU7–LU11 and LI1
穴位：肺经 LU7–LU11 与大肠经商阳
goals: Locate Lieque, Jingqu, Taiyuan, Yuji, Shaoshang and Shangyang on your own hand.
在自己手上找到列缺、经渠、太渊、鱼际、少商、商阳。
Use the forearm cun and the nail-corner rule to place them.
用前臂骨度分寸和指甲角法定位。
Name the radial artery and the tendons around each point.
说出每个穴位旁边的桡动脉和肌腱。

blocks.en: From Kongzui the lung meridian runs to the radial side of the wrist: Lieque on the radial edge, Jingqu and Taiyuan beside the radial pulse, then across the thenar eminence (Yuji) to the radial corner of the thumbnail (Shaoshang). A branch from Lieque goes to the radial side of the index finger, where the large intestine meridian begins at Shangyang.
blocks.zh: 肺经从孔最下行到腕部桡侧：列缺在桡侧缘，经渠、太渊在桡动脉搏动处旁，再经大鱼际（鱼际）到拇指指甲桡侧角（少商）。从列缺分出的支脉到食指桡侧，大肠经由此从商阳开始。

blocks.en: Right hand, palm forward. Red: lung meridian points; teal: LI1. The ruler on the ulnar side counts cun up from the distal wrist crease. The radial artery is drawn in a lighter red than the meridian.
blocks.zh: 右手掌面（解剖学姿势）。红点为肺经穴，青色为商阳；尺侧标尺从腕掌侧远端横纹往上数寸。桡动脉用比经络浅的红色画出。

blocks.en: How to find them
blocks.zh: 怎么找

blocks.en: A: radial side of the right wrist. Lieque lies in the groove between the EPB and APL tendons, 1.5 cun above the crease; with the webs of both hands crossed, the index fingertip lands on it. B: jing-well points 0.1 F-cun out from the radial corner of the nail.
blocks.zh: A：右腕桡侧面观。列缺在拇短伸肌腱与拇长展肌腱之间的沟中，腕横纹上 1.5 寸；两手虎口交叉时食指尖正落在这里。B：井穴在指甲桡侧角外 0.1 指寸。

blocks.en: What lies beneath Taiyuan and Lieque
blocks.zh: 太渊、列缺深面有什么

blocks.en: Layers from skin to deep structures. Not to scale and not a needling depth.
blocks.zh: 从皮肤到深层结构的层次；不按比例，不表示进针深度。

blocks.en: At the wrist the radial artery lies between the flexor carpi radialis tendon and the abductor pollicis longus tendon. Taiyuan sits on it and Jingqu just radial to it, so the pulse is the landmark to find and the structure to avoid. At Lieque, the cephalic vein tributaries and the superficial branch of the radial nerve lie just under the skin.
blocks.zh: 在腕部，桡动脉位于桡侧腕屈肌腱与拇长展肌腱之间。太渊就在动脉上，经渠紧贴其桡侧，所以脉搏既是定位标志，也是要避开的结构。列缺处，头静脉属支和桡神经浅支就在皮下。

check: Where is Lieque (LU7) by GB/T 12346-2021, and what are its special-point categories? Which nearby structures should you keep in mind when needling?
按 GB/T 12346-2021，列缺（LU7）位于何处？属于哪些特定穴？针刺时要注意附近哪些结构？

LU7 is on the lateral forearm, 1.5 cun above the distal palmar wrist crease, between the extensor pollicis brevis and abductor pollicis longus tendons, in the groove of the APL tendon. It is the luo-connecting point of the Lung meridian and an eight-confluent (bamai jiaohui) point linked to the Conception Vessel (Ren mai). Tributaries of the cephalic vein and the superficial branch of the radial nerve lie superficially, so it is needled obliquely toward the elbow, 0.5–0.8 cun.
列缺在前臂外侧，腕掌侧远端横纹上1.5寸，拇短伸肌腱与拇长展肌腱之间，拇长展肌腱沟的凹陷中。为肺经络穴，八脉交会穴（通任脉）。浅层有头静脉属支和桡神经浅支，故向肘部斜刺0.5~0.8寸。
Between which two tendons does Taiyuan lie, and what runs there?
太渊位于哪两条肌腱之间？那里有什么结构？
Between the flexor carpi radialis tendon (ulnar side) and the abductor pollicis longus tendon (radial side); the radial artery and veins run there.
在桡侧腕屈肌腱（尺侧）与拇长展肌腱（桡侧）之间；桡动脉和桡静脉就在这里。
Where exactly is Shaoshang?
少商的准确位置在哪里？
On the radial side of the thumb, 0.1 F-cun out from the radial corner of the nail, where a line along the radial nail border meets a line along the nail base.
在拇指桡侧，指甲桡侧角外 0.1 指寸：沿指甲桡侧缘画线与沿甲根画线的交点处。
take: Lieque: radial edge, 1.5 cun, between EPB and APL. Jingqu: 1 cun, beside the radial artery. Taiyuan: on the crease, on the radial pulse. Yuji: thenar edge, middle of the 1st metacarpal. Shaoshang and Shangyang: 0.1 F-cun from the radial nail corner of the thumb and index finger.
列缺：桡侧缘，1.5 寸，拇短伸肌腱与拇长展肌腱之间。经渠：1 寸，紧贴桡动脉。太渊：腕横纹上，桡动脉搏动处。鱼际：第 1 掌骨中点桡侧赤白肉际。少商、商阳：拇指、食指指甲桡侧角外 0.1 指寸。

整理与复习
goals: Recall all six points and both muscles without looking.
不看页面，说出今天的 6 个穴位和 2 块肌肉。

blocks.zh: 5.1 一页总结

blocks.en: 5.2 The lung meridian song, now complete
blocks.zh: 5.2 肺经穴歌：今天全部学完
手太阴肺十一穴，中府云门天府诀，侠白尺泽孔最存，列缺经渠太渊涉，鱼际少商如韭叶。
blocks.label: 经穴歌（传统）

blocks.en: With today's five points you have learned all eleven points of the lung meridian. Tomorrow the large intestine meridian continues from Shangyang along the index finger to the hand and wrist.
blocks.zh: 加上今天的 5 个，肺经 11 个穴位全部学完。明天大肠经从商阳沿食指继续到手背和腕部。

blocks.zh: 5.3 读音表

title: English reading: the force couple for upward rotation
英文短读：上回旋力偶
goals: Read a short biomechanics passage without translating word by word.
读一段生物力学短文，不逐词翻译。
Use 'force couple', 'moment' and 'take over' in your own sentence.
用 force couple、moment 和 take over 各造一个句子。

blocks.en: Raising the arm overhead requires the scapula to rotate upward, and no single muscle can do this alone.
blocks.zh: 把手臂举过头顶需要肩胛骨上回旋，而单靠一块肌肉无法完成。

blocks.en: The serratus anterior acts with the upper and lower fibers of the trapezius to sustain upward rotation, and together they form a force couple.
blocks.zh: 前锯肌与斜方肌上、下部纤维协同维持上回旋，三者共同构成一个力偶。

blocks.en: Early in elevation, the upper trapezius and serratus anterior produce upward-rotation moments around an axis near the sternoclavicular joint.
blocks.zh: 上举早期，斜方肌上部和前锯肌围绕胸锁关节附近的轴产生上回旋力矩。

blocks.en: Once tension in the costoclavicular ligament stops further elevation of the clavicle, the axis moves to the acromioclavicular joint, and the lower trapezius and serratus anterior take over.
blocks.zh: 当肋锁韧带的张力阻止锁骨继续上抬后，旋转轴移到肩锁关节，由斜方肌下部和前锯肌接手。

blocks.en: If the long thoracic nerve is injured, the serratus anterior can no longer hold the scapula against the chest wall, and medial winging appears.
blocks.zh: 如果胸长神经受损，前锯肌就无法使肩胛骨贴紧胸壁，出现内侧型翼状肩胛。

blocks.note: 穴位定位依据 GB/T 12346-2021《经穴名称与定位》与 WHO 2008 标准

check: Write one sentence with 'take over' about the lower trapezius.
用 take over 写一句关于斜方肌下部的英文句子。
Example: Late in elevation, the lower trapezius takes over from the upper trapezius.
例句：上举后期，斜方肌下部接替斜方肌上部。
What stops the clavicle from rising further, and what changes when it does?
什么阻止锁骨继续上抬？上抬受阻后有什么变化？
Tension in the costoclavicular ligament; the rotation axis moves from near the sternoclavicular joint to the acromioclavicular joint.
肋锁韧带的张力；旋转轴从胸锁关节附近移到肩锁关节。
